categories.main_business_segments: CNOOC Limited primarily operates in upstream oil and natural gas exploration, development, production, and sales. It also has a trading business segment involved in the sale of crude oil and natural gas. The company engages in both independent operations and cooperation projects, including production sharing contracts (PSCs).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced offshore oil and gas exploration and development technologies, including ultra deepwater oil and gas field development engineering, enhanced water flooding, production stimulation technologies, and smart oilfield digital and intelligent construction. It also uses thermal recovery for heavy oil and has developed offshore mobile thermal recovery platforms and offshore high-temperature flue gas waste heat generation systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CNOOC Limited serves primarily domestic customers in China, including CNOOC Group, Sinopec Group, and local private refineries. Overseas, it sells crude oil and natural gas in international markets benchmarked against global oil prices. Its customers span multiple countries and regions, with 64% of revenues generated from PRC customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in offshore China regions such as Bohai, Western South China Sea, Eastern South China Sea, East China Sea, and onshore China. Overseas operations span Asia (Indonesia, Iraq, UAE), Oceania (Australia), Africa (Nigeria, Uganda, Mozambique, Gabon), North America (U.S., Canada, Mexico, Trinidad and Tobago), South America (Brazil, Guyana, Colombia, Argentina), and Europe (UK North Sea, Russia).
categories.supply_chain_position: CNOOC Limited operates primarily upstream in the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on exploration, development, production, and sales of crude oil and natural gas. It also has a trading segment that handles the sale and marketing of these products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes increasing reserves and production through exploration and development, emphasizing large and medium-sized fields and frontier exploration. It focuses on technological innovation, including digital transformation and smart oilfields, and promotes green and low-carbon development, such as offshore wind power and CCS/CCUS technologies. The company also aims to maintain cost competitiveness and financial prudence.
categories.revenue_model: CNOOC Limited generates revenue primarily through the sale of crude oil and natural gas. Sales are conducted domestically and internationally, with prices benchmarked against global oil benchmarks like Brent, Dubai, Oman, and WTI. The company also earns revenue from trading activities and provides various services under continuing connected transactions with its controlling shareholder and affiliates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CNOOC Limited is the largest offshore crude oil and natural gas producer in China and one of the largest independent oil and gas exploration and production companies globally. It holds a leading position in offshore China and has a diversified global asset portfolio. The company competes with other major international oil and gas producers and faces competition in exploration rights, technology, and market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, CNOOC Limited had total assets of approximately RMB1,056.3 billion and net proved reserves of about 7.27 billion BOE. The company achieved a net production of approximately 1.99 million BOE/day and operating revenues of RMB420.5 billion with a net profit attributable to equity shareholders of RMB137.9 billion, reflecting steady growth in reserves, production, and profitability. The company maintains a low gearing ratio of 10.9% and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CNOOC Limited emphasizes its abundant oil and gas resources, leading production growth capacity, and extensive offshore China expertise. It differentiates through advanced technological capabilities in ultra deepwater exploration and development, smart oilfield construction, and integrated green and low-carbon initiatives. The company also highlights its cost competitiveness, diversified global asset base, and commitment to sustainable and high-quality development.
